propositions: rebar transition reports a lock error to stderr with exit code 0 approximately 60 seconds after a close has already durably committed, silently downgrading the ticket to closed-without-completion-signature

the close_ticket function commits the STATUS event and releases its lock before the signing tail runs, causing a subsequent SigningError during completion signature append to be caught and logged as a warning without propagating failure information to the caller
the close_ticket return payload contains no field indicating whether the completion signature succeeded or failed, making the loss undetectable programmatically by library, CLI, or MCP consumers

a SigningError (whether from transient lock timeout or permanent missing ssh-keygen) must be reported to the caller with a machine-readable cause field and honest messaging that the close landed successfully but only the signature append failed
completion_signature should be absent from the return payload for non-close transitions and for idea-to-closed transitions, since those do not involve a completion attestation
the stderr message must explicitly state the ticket IS CLOSED and the close committed before describing the signature failure, preventing callers from re-running the transition
